baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books. Android retains schema 17 and the desktop archive format; update the same application with its retained signing key and preserve complete exported copies with separate keys for rollback. Newer schemas are refused before unsupported presets without changing the library.
backup-recovery.note: Android preserves originals and uncertain private staging, verifies archives before provider output and publishes copied books database last. Imports and pre-write exports are disposable; uncertain writes retain ciphertext only, with startup sweeping and explicit disposal.

editor.note: Android adds localized archive preview, explicit separate-copy confirmation and guarded transfer admission through cancellation. Transfers now dispose disposable stages, offer localized leftover-file disposal and keep status responsive during transfer I/O.

encryption.note: The existing age format gains bounded mobile extraction and authenticated capability inspection; ciphertext staging uses private file permissions. Terminal export cleanup removes plaintext snapshots and recovery keys; only uncertain ciphertext remains.

maintenance.note: Compatibility guidance documents Android resource limits, ordered capability refusals, retained staging and the limits of automated verification. Compatibility guidance describes automatic cleanup, explicit disposal, unavailable transfer storage, and exact SQLite probe behavior.

native-packaging.note: The source remains version 0.0.2 with Android code 2. Release preparation raises both before an in-place update; the signing flow and application identifier remain unchanged.
